references.text: God let you hear his voice from heaven to teach you, and on earth he let you see his great fire, and you heard his words right out of the fire.
The Lord spoke with you face to face on the mountain, right out of the fire.
These words the Lord spoke to your entire assembly on the mountain, right out of the fire, cloud, and darkness, in a loud voice, and he added nothing more.
You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven, giving them right statutes and true laws.
See that you do not reject him who speaks! For if those did not escape who rejected him who spoke on earth, how much less shall we escape if we turn away from him who speaks from heaven?
Confirmation of the same sequence of events: God's speech from the mountain and the instruction to Moses to convey it.
